title: LUMENIS App Experience binding registry
description: Canonical, fail-closed inventory for all Experience screens and backend bindings. Source disagreements are preserved as claims; no unverified API, permission, evidence lineage, actor scope, or behavior is promoted to verified truth.

canonical_owner_rules.Account: Authenticated account actor; selected CTH/BMP lens must remain explicit. Actual auth and scope enforcement UNKNOWN.
canonical_owner_rules.CTH: Subject-first commercial-operations lens; preserve active Subject identity and lineage. Actual actor/scope binding UNKNOWN.
canonical_owner_rules.BMP: Brand/Market-first primary-focus lens; preserve selected brand/market identity and lineage. Actual actor/scope binding UNKNOWN.
canonical_owner_rules.AI: Inherit authenticated caller and selected CTH/BMP lens; never widen caller scope. Actual propagation UNKNOWN.
canonical_owner_rules.SYSTEM: Infrastructure and platform operations only; must not create a third business-product truth. Actual actor/scope binding UNKNOWN.
canonical_owner_rules.Shared: Shared capabilities serve CTH/BMP with origin domain and source lineage preserved. Actual propagation UNKNOWN.

source_disagreement_summary.unknown_bindings: 42 BOUND, 9 BLOCKED_BY_EXTERNAL_DEPENDENCY, 3 INTENTIONALLY_NOT_APPLICABLE; owner values are CODEX or DOUBAO->CODEX task assignees, not canonical component ownership.
source_disagreement_summary.BINDING_MATRIX: 54 rows remain CODEX_BINDING_REQUIRED / CODEX_VERIFY and owner CODEX.
source_disagreement_summary.VIEWMODEL_REGISTRY: 44 screen ViewModels exist; unknown_binding_keys and binding notes record UI contract gaps, not proof of production routes.
source_disagreement_summary.resolution: Preserve the richer ledger disposition as a source claim only. Mark every binding unverified until code-level canonical owner, caller scope, permission, lineage, read/write effect, and executable acceptance evidence agree.
